name: f4_chain_flips
note: Round 11 flips: a-style airborne swing chain; every release asks for a flip (trickEvery 1), every 2nd release is a sky launch; requested programs cycle backDouble, frontPikeSwan, corkscrew. A plain release only flips when the predicted fall leaves room (FitFlip: else backSingle, else no flip), so low releases stay plain.
